session_dialogue.text: Hello. How are you feeling today?
I'm feeling a bit anxious today. I messed up the insurance claim again, and I'm worried about the money.
That sounds really stressful. I can see how that would be frustrating. Have you talked to anyone about it yet?
No, I haven't. I keep thinking I should have handled it better on my own. I don't want to bother anyone, even if I need help.
It’s understandable to feel that way. But you don’t have to face everything alone. Would you like to talk about what’s been on your mind?
I just feel like I’m failing at being independent. Every time something goes wrong, I think I’m not good enough. I don’t know how to stop blaming myself.
That’s a heavy feeling to carry. It’s okay to feel that way, but you’re not alone in this. Let’s try to break it down together.
I keep thinking about how my brother still relies on our parents, and I feel like I’m not doing enough to be different. I’m scared I’ll end up like him.
It’s natural to compare yourself to others, but you’re not the same person. Let’s explore what being “different” means to you.
I want to be strong and not need anyone. But every time I mess up, I feel like I’m not strong enough. I don’t know how to keep going.
You’re trying so hard to be strong, and that’s admirable. But it’s okay to need support sometimes. Let’s find a way to honor your strength without being too hard on yourself.
I don’t know how to stop feeling like a failure. I keep thinking I should have done everything right, but I can’t seem to get it right.
It’s hard to feel like you’re not enough, but you’re doing the best you can. Let’s try to see what you’re already doing right, even if it feels small.
I guess I’m trying to manage everything on my own, even when it’s hard. I just wish I could stop feeling like I’m letting myself and everyone else down.
It’s brave of you to carry so much on your own. But you don’t have to do this alone anymore. Let’s find a way to share the weight.
I don’t know where to start, but I want to try. I just don’t want to feel like I’m failing anymore. I want to feel like I’m enough.
That’s a powerful step just to acknowledge how you’re feeling. You’re already enough, and it’s okay to take things one small step at a time.
Thank you. I don’t know if I believe that yet, but I’m trying to believe it. I’m tired of feeling like I’m not enough.
You’re not alone in feeling this way, and it’s okay to be tired. Taking the first step is already a sign of strength.
I know I’m not alone, but it still feels so heavy. I just want to feel lighter, even if just a little.
